She has said that "the song was as close to pure inspiration as I've ever experienced. The song wrote itself. It was written by something outside myself, through me."^([4]) According to Taylor, King told him that the song was a response to a line in his earlier song "Fire and Rain" ("I've seen lonely times when I could not find a friend").^([5][6]) King said in a 1972 interview that she "didn't write it with James or anybody really specifically in mind. But when James heard it he really liked it and wanted to record it".^([7]) Both King and Taylor recorded the song for their respective albums, and Taylor and Danny Kortchmar perform on both versions.
